title: GEMglGetString
description: return a string describing the current GL connection

messages.description: string to query: GL_VENDOR, GL_RENDERER, GL_VERSION or GL_EXTENSIONS

arguments.description: string to query: GL_VENDOR, GL_RENDERER, GL_VERSION or GL_EXTENSIONS

body: [GEMglGetString] calls glGetString() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glGetString in the OpenGL reference.
